name: research-quality
status: Owner approved rubric with accuracy imperative; held-out cases and full-run allowance not yet frozen/approved

rules: Owner reviews cases and thresholds before freeze
Do not tune prompts/models on held-out results
Record revisions and create a new held-out version after tuning
Use identical questions and per-run caps; log retrieval differences
Human review final outputs independently of model self-review

completion_requires: Owner-approved frozen rubric and held-out cases
Source/claim/numerical audits and blind human scoring
Published failures, resource use and coverage limitations
Owner acceptance or explicit failed gate

owner_approval.scope: Quality rubric, with explicit accuracy requirement
owner_approval.note: Rubric approval does not approve the proposed 192-call batch or accept any report.

gates.unknown_or_unanswerable_cases: Explicitly blocked with specific gaps; never count as successful answers

accuracy_policy.hard_gate: Any material accuracy error fails the case regardless of other scores.
accuracy_policy.verification: Audit material claims against dated evidence and original context; check arithmetic, units, periods, denominators, entity attribution and whether causal language is justified. Citation/excerpt matching alone is insufficient.
accuracy_policy.uncertainty: Do not fill unavailable facts with plausible assertions. Label estimates, forecasts and assumptions; distinguish lack of evidence from evidence of absence.
accuracy_policy.judgement: Human audit is required; neither source existence nor model self-review proves accuracy.
